Bibliography
============

This section contains references to documentation, tools, and resources used in this project.

Official Documentation
----------------------

MinIO Documentation
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

- `MinIO Official Documentation <https://docs.min.io/>`_
- `MinIO S3 API Reference <https://docs.min.io/minio/linux/reference/minio-server/minio-server.html>`_
- `MinIO Python SDK <https://docs.min.io/docs/python-client-quickstart-guide.html>`_
- `MinIO Client (mc) <https://docs.min.io/docs/minio-client-quickstart-guide.html>`_

DVC Documentation
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

- `DVC Official Documentation <https://dvc.org/doc>`_
- `DVC Remote Storage <https://dvc.org/doc/user-guide/data-management/remote-storage>`_
- `DVC Python API <https://dvc.org/doc/api-reference>`_

Docker Documentation
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

- `Docker Compose Documentation <https://docs.docker.com/compose/>`_
- `Docker Volumes <https://docs.docker.com/storage/volumes/>`_
- `Docker Networking <https://docs.docker.com/network/>`_

AWS S3 Compatibility
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

- `Amazon S3 API Reference <https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/Welcome.html>`_

- `Boto3 Documentation <https://boto3.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/index.html>`_

Books and Guides
----------------

Recommended Reading
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

- `Data Science from Scratch <https://www.oreilly.com/library/view/data-science-from/9781492041122/>`_ by Joel Grus

Standards and Specifications
----------------------------

S3 API Standards
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

- `AWS S3 REST API <https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_Operations.html>`_
- `HTTP/1.1 Specification <https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7230>`_
- `TLS 1.2/1.3 Specifications <https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5246>`_

Data Formats
~~~~~~~~~~~~

- `CSV Format <https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4180>`_
- `JSON Format <https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc8259>`_
- `Parquet Format <https://parquet.apache.org/documentation/latest/>`_

Tools and Software Versions
---------------------------

Software Versions Used
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

- MinIO: RELEASE.2025-02-28T09-55-16Z
- Docker: 20.10+
- Docker Compose: 2.0+
- Python: 3.8+
- DVC: 2.0+
- Boto3: 1.20+
- Sphinx: 5.0+

Compatibility Matrix
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

+------------+----------------+----------------+
| Component  | Min Version    | Recommended    |
+============+================+================+
| Docker     | 19.03          | 20.10+         |
+------------+----------------+----------------+
| Python     | 3.7            | 3.8+           |
+------------+----------------+----------------+
| DVC        | 2.0            | 2.10+          |
+------------+----------------+----------------+
| Boto3      | 1.17           | 1.20+          |
+------------+----------------+----------------+

Change Log
----------

Version History
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

**v1.0 (Current)**

- Initial release with Docker Compose setup
- Basic MinIO configuration
- DVC integration examples
- Comprehensive documentation

**Future Releases**

- Multi-node MinIO cluster support
- Advanced security configurations
- Monitoring and alerting integration
- CI/CD pipeline examples
